resources.string: Measure for about 30 seconds under stable reference conditions. In darkness you compensate sensor background; under illumination you also subtract the light present, giving relative measurements. For a dark measurement, cover the optical inputs with material opaque to near-infrared too and keep the LEDs in their normal operating state. The mean does not eliminate random noise or calibrate gain.
Proposal from %1$s readings. No settings have been changed.
Measurement interrupted or unavailable. Check the connection and sensor, then try again.
Reset correction factors to 1 and offsets to 0 for %1$s. Other calibration and optical-window settings are unchanged.
Resets the general multiplier and all optical-window channel multipliers to 1. Calibration is unchanged.
